title: A Fibre That Fires at Rest

scenes.tts: Mice that lack a cold-and-menthol channel were trained to report gentle warming of a forepaw.
scenes.visual: Title card: A Fibre That Fires at Rest. Then a mouse forepaw resting on a small square plate; a soft warm glow spreads from the plate.
scenes.narration: Mice that lack a cold-and-menthol channel were trained to report gentle warming of a forepaw.

scenes.tts: They failed completely. Why would a cold channel matter for warmth?
scenes.visual: Question on screen: why would a cold channel matter for warmth? A small label: mice lacking TRPM8.
scenes.narration: They failed completely. Why would a cold channel matter for warmth?

scenes.tts: A transducer turns a stimulus into an electrical signal. For temperature, the candidates are ion channels.
scenes.visual: A nerve ending in skin; a single channel protein in its membrane is highlighted. Label: transducer, stimulus in, electrical signal out.
scenes.narration: A transducer turns a stimulus into an electrical signal. For temperature, the candidates are ion channels.

scenes.tts: A line is one kind of sensory fibre and what it reports. A channel sits in a line.
scenes.visual: Zoom out: several fibres run from skin toward the spinal cord. One fibre is coloured and labelled line; the channel is a small mark on its ending. Above, a temperature band rising left to right, with four segments labelled cold, cool, warm, noxious heat, and no numbers or fixed boundaries.
scenes.narration: A line is one kind of sensory fibre and what it reports. A channel sits in a line.

scenes.tts: Most fibres in this story are C fibres. They are thin, unmyelinated and slow.
scenes.visual: A fibre cross-section: a thin bare C fibre. Labels: C fibre, unmyelinated, slow. A smaller side note: Aδ fibres, thinly myelinated, faster.
scenes.narration: Most fibres in this story are C fibres. They are thin, unmyelinated and slow.

scenes.tts: For gentle cooling, the main established transducer is T R P M eight.
scenes.caption: For gentle cooling, the main established transducer is TRPM8.
scenes.visual: The cool segment of the band lights up; a channel icon labelled TRPM8 sits under it.
scenes.narration: For gentle cooling, the main established transducer is TRPM8.

scenes.tts: A fibre that is silent at rest can report a change only by starting to fire.
scenes.visual: A spike raster for one fibre: a flat empty line, then a few ticks appear when a stimulus bar starts. Label: constructed schematic.
scenes.narration: A fibre that is silent at rest can report a change only by starting to fire.

scenes.tts: In twenty twenty, one study recorded single fibres from mouse forepaw skin kept alive with its nerve.
scenes.caption: In 2020, one study recorded single fibres from mouse forepaw skin kept alive with its nerve.
scenes.visual: A skin patch in a small bath with its nerve leading to a recording electrode. Label: skin-nerve preparation, mouse forepaw, 2020.
scenes.narration: In 2020, one study recorded single fibres from mouse forepaw skin kept alive with its nerve.

scenes.tts: Awake forepaw skin measured twenty-six to twenty-eight degrees. So they also used a bath at twenty-seven.
scenes.caption: Awake forepaw skin measured 26 to 28 degrees. So they also used a bath at 27.
scenes.visual: A thermal-camera style image of a mouse forepaw with an on-screen range: 26 to 28 °C. The bath beside it is labelled 27 °C.
scenes.narration: Awake forepaw skin measured 26 to 28 degrees. So they also used a bath at 27.

scenes.tts: Suppose a fibre already fires slowly at rest. What can it report that a silent fibre cannot?
scenes.visual: A second raster: steady, sparse ticks with no stimulus. Question on screen: what can this fibre report that a silent one cannot?
scenes.narration: Suppose a fibre already fires slowly at rest. What can it report that a silent fibre cannot?

scenes.tts: It can report change in both directions. Faster for one, slower for the other.
scenes.visual: The steady raster splits into two: ticks crowd together under a cooling bar, and thin out under a warming bar.
scenes.narration: It can report change in both directions. Faster for one, slower for the other.

scenes.tts: In the twenty-seven degree bath, one population did exactly that. These were cool-sensitive C fibres.
scenes.caption: In the 27 degree bath, one population did exactly that. These were cool-sensitive C fibres.
scenes.visual: Label over the raster: cool-sensitive C fibre, ongoing activity, 27 °C bath. Small on-screen note: about 19% of temperature-sensitive fibres; 0.2 to 6 Hz at rest.
scenes.narration: In the 27 degree bath, one population did exactly that. These were cool-sensitive C fibres.

scenes.tts: With no stimulus, they fired slowly and steadily. Cooling makes such fibres fire faster.
scenes.visual: Cooling bar under the raster; ticks become denser; a rate trace beneath it rises.
scenes.narration: With no stimulus, they fired slowly and steadily. Cooling makes such fibres fire faster.

scenes.tts: Warming made them fire slower.
scenes.visual: Warming bar under the raster; ticks thin out; the rate trace beneath it falls. Label: constructed schematic.
scenes.narration: Warming made them fire slower.

scenes.tts: A second kind, warm-excited C fibres, had little ongoing firing. Warming made them fire faster.
scenes.visual: A second raster under the first, on the same time axis: nearly empty at rest, more ticks under the warming bar. Label: warm-excited polymodal C fibre.
scenes.narration: A second kind, warm-excited C fibres, had little ongoing firing. Warming made them fire faster.

scenes.tts: In the usual thirty-two degree bath, no such fibres had been seen.
scenes.caption: In the usual 32 degree bath, no such fibres had been seen.
scenes.visual: The bath label changes to 32 °C. The cool fibre's raster is replaced by a grey panel labelled: not seen in a 32 °C bath. No blank trace is drawn.
scenes.narration: In the usual 32 degree bath, no such fibres had been seen.

scenes.tts: Semicircular canal fibres in the inner ear use a similar design. They fire at rest, so rotation can speed them up or slow them down.
scenes.visual: A head icon turning left then right about one axis; one fibre labelled semicircular-canal afferent; its raster speeds up for one turn and slows for the other.
scenes.narration: Semicircular canal fibres in the inner ear use a similar design. They fire at rest, so rotation can speed them up or slow them down.

scenes.tts: The one idea: skin temperature is read from a few lines at once, not one channel per feeling.
scenes.visual: On-screen text builds: The one idea. Skin temperature is read from a few afferent lines at once, not from one channel per feeling.
scenes.narration: The one idea: skin temperature is read from a few lines at once, not one channel per feeling.

scenes.tts: A line that fires at rest can signal both ways. The cool line speeds up on cooling and slows on warming.
scenes.visual: The text adds: the TRPM8-dependent cool line speeds up when skin cools and slows down when it warms. The two rasters stay visible beneath.
scenes.narration: A line that fires at rest can signal both ways. The cool line speeds up on cooling and slows on warming.

scenes.tts: So a channel that supplies a line's firing matters for everything that reads that line. That is how losing a cool channel can cost warmth.
scenes.visual: The text adds: a channel that supplies a line's activity matters for every sensation that reads that line. The TRPM8 icon sits on the cool line, and the cool line is linked by arrows to both cool and warm.
scenes.narration: So a channel that supplies a line's firing matters for everything that reads that line. That is how losing a cool channel can cost warmth.

scenes.tts: This is a mouse forepaw result. The circuit that reads the lines has not been identified.
scenes.visual: Scope note on screen: mouse forepaw; the central circuit that reads the lines is unknown.
scenes.narration: This is a mouse forepaw result. The circuit that reads the lines has not been identified.

scenes.tts: The picture to keep: a fibre that fires at rest can say warmer by going quiet.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the cool fibre's raster thinning under the warming bar, with the words: warmer, said by going quiet.
scenes.narration: The picture to keep: a fibre that fires at rest can say warmer by going quiet.
